First public release of **CareerPilot AI**, an AI career assistant for students and fresh graduates.

**Web app:** https://careerpilot-ai-762bb.web.app
**Android:** download `CareerPilot-AI-v1.0.0.apk` below, open it on your phone and allow "Install unknown apps" when Android asks.

### What it does
- **Resume analysis:** upload a PDF CV and get a 3-layer ATS score (format rules, keywords learned from real job postings, meaning match) with concrete fixes and an AI bullet rewriter.
- **Career guidance:** an adaptive questionnaire plus your CV give your top role matches (500+ roles), your skill gaps and a week-by-week learning roadmap.
- **Jobs:** remote jobs open to applicants from Pakistan, with a match percentage for each.
- **Interview coach:** a live spoken interview (5, 10 or 15 minutes) in **English or Urdu**, with follow-up questions, speech analysis and a graded report. Eye-contact tracking works in the web app.
- **Account:** email or Google sign-in, profile, dashboard, light and dark mode.

### Good to know
- The server sleeps when nobody is using it; the first action after a quiet period can take a few seconds longer.
- Your CV text is never sent to the AI service with your name, email, phone or links.

To check the download: the SHA-256 checksum of the APK is in `CareerPilot-AI-v1.0.0.apk.sha256`.
